name: Stovkahra
description: Stovkahra (Slovak: 'Hundred Game' or 'Hundreth') is a trick-taking card game for 4 players in fixed partnerships. It is played with a 32-card German or French-suited deck (7-Ace). The goal is to reach 100 points first by winning point cards (Ace, Ten, King, Queen, Jack) and melding combinations.

history.origins: Trappola originated in Venice (Cardano, 1564) and spread to Central Europe, where it developed many variations. Stovkahra (Brčko) is a surviving form played in the Czech village of Šumice in Romania's Banát region. Researched by Tomáš Svoboda in 1997 and published in The Playing-Card; it retains Trappola point values and bonuses using a German 32-card pack after original Trappola cards ceased production in 1944.
timeline: 1997: Researched by Tomáš Svoboda; rules published in The Playing-Card (IPCS).

setup.deck: German suited 32-card pack (7 to Ace); eight cards each in 3-2-3 packets; bottom card shown for trump.
setup.dealing: Deal 8 cards each (4-4 or 3-2-3). Last card turned for Trump.

rules.objective: Be the first team to score 100 or more points. Points are scored for declared combinations (three or four of a rank), for cards taken in tricks (Ace 6, King 5, Ober 4, Unter 3; tens and below 0), and as bonuses for winning the last trick (6), a middle trick with a seven (10), the last trick with a seven (26), or the first trick with a seven (52).
rules.gameplay: Four players in fixed partnerships (partners opposite). Deal 8 cards each (3-2-3); bottom card of the pack is shown and its suit is trumps. Before the first trick, players may declare combinations (three or four aces, tens, sevens, kings, or knaves) for points; only declared combinations count. Player to dealer's left leads. Must follow suit; if unable, must play a trump. Must beat the highest card in the trick if possible. Trick is won by the highest trump, or highest of led suit if no trump. Winner of each trick leads to the next. A player may call "dost" (enough) when their team believes they have reached 100 points to stop play and count; if correct they win the game (1 or 2 brčka depending on opponents' score); if wrong the opponents win 2 brčka. First team to 10 brček wins the series.
keyRules: Must follow suit; if void in led suit must play a trump.
Must beat the current highest card in the trick if able.
Only declared combinations (stated before first trick) are scored.
First team to 100 points wins the deal; call "dost" to stop play and count.
First team to 10 brček (matchsticks) wins the series.

strategy.basic: Count trumps. Declare marriages early for points. Lead aces to draw out tens. Don't waste trumps on small tricks.

variations.name: Play to 20 brček
variations.description: When a team reaches 10 brček, continue the series to 20. If the first team to 10 also reaches 20 first they win two series; if the other team reaches 20 first the result is a draw.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation changes series target only; no engine overrides needed.
